parsed.rationale: The evidence supports hypothesis h1 as the most likely root cause. The deployment of payment-svc version 2.5.0 (d-576) introduced a database connection pool timeout issue, which directly caused HTTP 503 errors in payment-svc (log:3bf4f24e33), which in turn caused checkout-svc to fail with HTTP 503 errors (log:9110a7c06d), leading to the high error rate (metric:4d19b12fad).
